proposal.summary: Adobe After Effects 22.0 (and earlier) and 18.4.2 (and earlier) have an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could disclose sensitive memory and be used to bypass mitigations such as ASLR; exploitation requires a victim to open a malicious file.
proposal.affected_product: Adobe After Effects versions 22.0 (and earlier) and 18.4.2 (and earlier)
proposal.cwe_quote: out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

AV.quote: a victim must open a malicious file.

PR.quote: a victim must open a malicious file.

UI.quote: a victim must open a malicious file.

C.quote: could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vendor's technical advisory or patch, verify fixed versions, and request a CVE identifier if none exists; test whether the vendor patch mitigates the out-of-bounds read and ASLR bypass.
